supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity observed from 13:40 through 14:10 UTC was attributed to cmupdate.exe running from Ben Carter's user-profile AppData directory, rather than the inventory-listed ChartMate updater path under Program Files.

The updater process connected at approximately five-minute intervals to update.chartmate-imaging.net; the inventory identifies update.chartmate-imaging.com as the approved ChartMate update host. This domain discrepancy, combined with the unapproved executable location, makes the activity suspicious.

A network logon to WS-OHADDAD-01 used the omar.haddad account with WS-BCARTER-01 as the source workstation. The inventory says remote administration is only done from WS-OHADDAD-01, so this is inconsistent with the stated practice.
Explorer changed Ben Carter's Internet Settings ProxyEnable value to 0 during the review window.
Dropbox was launched from WS-BCARTER-01, although the inventory says no file-sharing or cloud-storage services beyond those listed are approved.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels and some inspected requests, but do not establish the full contents of the ChartMate-related encrypted sessions.
The supplied records do not include a hash, signature validation, file provenance, or file contents for the AppData cmupdate.exe executable.
The proxy-setting change is recorded, but the evidence does not show whether it bypassed proxy controls or affected the observed traffic.
The account-validation record and network logon show activity involving omar.haddad from WS-BCARTER-01, but do not establish who initiated it or why.
claims_not_established: That update.chartmate-imaging.net is attacker-controlled or that the AppData executable is definitively malicious.
That data was exfiltrated or that the Dropbox client uploaded organizational data.
That Ben Carter knowingly performed the suspicious actions, rather than the workstation or account being compromised.
That the proxy setting change enabled a successful direct connection or evasion of monitoring.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect and analyze the AppData cmupdate.exe file, including its hash, signature, version, origin, and relationship to the approved ChartMate updater.
Validate the ownership and legitimacy of update.chartmate-imaging.net and obtain DNS, certificate, and proxy inspection details for its sessions.
Review endpoint and proxy telemetry for Dropbox file access, synchronization, and uploads.
Investigate the omar.haddad authentication from WS-BCARTER-01, including source process, authentication outcome details, and activity on WS-OHADDAD-01.
Determine the actor and purpose of the ProxyEnable change and whether any traffic bypassed the proxy.
